title: Carne con Chivo
description: A traditional Mexican dish made with tender goat meat and a tangy slaw. Serve with warm tortillas and your favorite hot sauce.
instructions: Heat the lard in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Brown the goat meat on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the goat meat from the skillet and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the shredded cabbage to the skillet and cook until slightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Return the goat meat to the skillet and add the dried oregano, salt, and black pepper.
Cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the goat meat is tender.
Serve the goat meat with the slaw on top and warm tortillas on the side.
